messages:
elaine: Heads up — we need final GA sign-off for Predictor-v2. Gaps I see: precise SLA language (p95 vs p99), customer-facing support blurb, oncall/responder list, monitoring alerts + runbooks, docs walkthrough, and pricing buckets for Dedicated vs Hosted. Who can own which by EOD tomorrow? :eyes:

kevin: I can own SLA text + recommended SLOs. Quick note: single-token p99 is noisy; suggest p95 200ms, p99 600ms for small models, and call out header vs payload latency. I'll draft and link it here.

nina: Support rota: I can map current oncall to a new predictor route. Need escalation emails and a billing dispute template from legal to finish playbook.

sam: Monitoring/runbooks: I'll add alert rules and runbooks. Proposed alerts:
```
- predictor_latency_p99 > 600ms for 5m -> P2 (investigate latency tail)
- predictor_error_rate > 0.5% for 10m -> P1 (rollback consideration)
- predictor_prefix_cache_miss > 20% for 15m -> P3 (performance tweak)
```
I'll push a Grafana dashboard and smoke queries.

maria: Pricing: I'll draft three public tiers (Dev / Standard / Dedicated reserved) and example unit economics. Need input on burst policy and discounting for committed capacity.

dav: Docs: I'll write the SDK walkthrough, upgrade note (default quantization change), and a short "what-we-tell-customers" snippet for support.

ops-bot: deploybot: Canary scheduled 2026-05-15 04:00 UTC.

kevin: Uploaded SLA draft: /docs/drafts/predictor-v2-sla.md — PTAL @elaine @maria. Including fallback policy to lighter model when capacity constrained.

elaine: Nina, can you drop escalation list + who-handles-invoice-disputes by EOD? Also one-sentence legal summary for the ship doc.

nina: Sending current rotas now. Will tag infra vs billing responders. Small blocker: billing playbook needs legal refund cap template. Looping legal.

sam: Dashboard placed at grafana/predictor-v2 (id: 4321). QA: can you run a smoke suite against the canary before the window? If latencies breach p95 we abort.

dav: QA ask: can we get a 1-hour dedicated-pool burnin? @kevin does autoscale handle short bursts?

kevin: Autoscale supports burst windows. Example config:
```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 20
  burst_window_s: 3600
```
I'll add this to the SLA appendix.

maria: Commercial review scheduled 2026-05-14 16:00 UTC — invited Product and Sales. Pricing sheet (internal): https://tiny.redwood/pricing-predictor-v2

elaine: Action summary for EOD tomorrow:
- Kevin: SLA text + autoscale sample
- Nina: Oncall + escalation list + billing playbook stub
- Sam: Dashboards + alert runbooks + smoke queries
- Dav: Docs + SDK examples + upgrade note + customer blurb
- Maria: Pricing tiers + commercial note
If you hit blockers, mark urgent in this thread.

kevin: Note: include SLA fallback language for model variant routing and customer-visible degradation messaging.

dav: I'll draft the customer-facing "degradation" blurb for support to reuse.

sam: I'll run the canary smoke tomorrow morning and post results. If p95 latency spikes are observed we'll gate.

ops-bot: reminder: rollout checklist -> https://tiny.redwood/rollout-checklist

elaine: Thanks team. I'll stitch deliverables into the shiproom doc tomorrow AM. :rocket:
